what: Four white walls cover the hero (the top and bottom strips leave only 10rem in the middle of the screen, the left and right are halves). After .2s the left and right halves are clipped 50px each from the center (clip-path inset), opening a vertical gap over 1s so the video behind shows as a thin window. At 1.3s the four walls slide outward (top −100%, bottom 100%, left −100%, right 100%) over .7s cubic-bezier(.76,0,.24,1). The guide text at the center of the wall switches off in .5s as the gap opens. Scrolling is locked until the walls are gone

options.open: Time when the gap starts to open (sec), default .2
options.exit: When the wall starts to drop out (sec), default 1.3 — 0 means it drops as soon as it opens
options.window: Half of the center height left by the top and bottom bands (rem), default 5
options.skip: If this sessionStorage key is 1, skip the wall and go straight to the end state (when arriving from within the same site), default none
options.[data-fx-part=lead]: (optional) Guide text at the center above the wall — fades out in .5s easeInOut when the gap opens
options.fx:done: Event fired from the element once all walls are gone — hook the next motion here, such as title letters appearing

use: Your guide line here
note: The part covers its positioned parent (the first Hero panel with a position). The original changes state with two framer-motion setTimeouts (200·1300ms) — the copy puts the same timings into GSAP timeline slots.
